title: SandpaneChangeSet
description: git.review result: the ACTUAL change set versus the task's recorded base revision, including untracked files (specs/06 §6, specs/08 T15). Never a mocked-up diff. A5 adds the optional repoPath, uninspected and changes[].oldPath (design 2026-10-09 §3.5 item 2).

baseCommit.description: Recorded base revision the task started from.

hostDirty.description: True when the host working tree has uncommitted changes at review time.

repoPath.description: A5 (additive, optional): the canonical host repository root of the task - the integration target hostDirty describes.

uninspected.description: A5 (additive, optional): paths Core could not inspect. Defined but never produced in A5: a repository with submodules is still refused with VALIDATION_FAILED, never returned as a partial list.

path.description: Exactly as git reports it (NUL-separated since A5, never C-quoted). git.diff accepts only this exact string.

oldPath.description: A5 (additive, optional): the pre-rename path; set only for status renamed.
